## Description

Please include a summary of the change, motivation, and context.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature altering existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI / Automation improvement

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to repository style conventions and passes `PSScriptAnalyzer`.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests covering the change (`Invoke-Pester`).
- [ ] Full local verification passes (`./scripts/verify.ps1 full` / `bash scripts/verify.sh full`).
- [ ] All new assets or scripts in `samples/` have valid `.meta` files.
- [ ] Third-party GitHub Actions are pinned to verified 40-character commit SHAs.
- [ ] Clean-room compliance: No proprietary or confidential client references are included.
